note: Distance between the price a Stock Token trades at on chain and the Chainlink answer a lending market liquidates against. Both quote the raw token, so nothing is unwound from either. Positive means the traded price is above the oracle.
method: The deepest USDG pool per token, read in the same instant as every feed, through one Multicall3 batch each. A pool with no liquidity is skipped rather than ranked last: its price is whatever the last trade left behind. Each run appends its summary to the history, labelled with the market session, so the difference between an open market and a frozen feed becomes measurable rather than asserted.
